question: What is the gap between Purnia and Nalanda in training completion and 6-month employment rates in 2023?

view.title: Purnia vs Nalanda: Training Completion and 6-Month Employment by Year
view.note: Two rates are shown for Purnia and Nalanda across both years. Training completion rate is the number of women who completed training divided by the number enrolled, expressed as a percentage. Employment rate is the number of women employed at 6 months divided by the number enrolled, expressed as a percentage. The insight below states the gap between Purnia and Nalanda in 2023 in percentage points.
